rationale: The reclaim structure that justified the entry is intact — price at $51.97 still sits above session VWAP ($51.86) and the 9-EMA ($51.94), and the drift off the $52.05 high is occurring on sharply fading volume (5.5k→~1–2k per minute), which reads as consolidation under the high rather than distribution. Remaining reward-to-risk to the $52.42 target is roughly 3.5:1 against the $51.84 invalidation, and the risk from here (~$25 to the stop) is trivial against the $465 loss budget. Momentum has stalled rather than reversed, so the mechanically consistent action is to hold with the original levels and let a VWAP break — not a 1-ATR drift — trigger the exit.
